shortDescription: Member check-in result view with multiple account states.
fullDescription: Displays the member check-in result screen with a search bar, top utility header, account summary banner, membership details, included amenities, and a full-width action footer. The view supports active-member success, past-due invalid-payment failure, and cancelled access-denied failure states through a state query parameter so one route can render multiple check-in outcomes without duplicating the screen structure.
